{{Quote|He was stronger than you'll ever be, but still he turned his back on us. Such are the temptations of the outlands.|Captain Frem to Alus, on Watcher Izax|<ref name="KOTET 6" />}}
'''Watcher Izax''' was the code name of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Eternal Empire agents|sleeper agent]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] who was sent to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. Though considered strong and loyal by his compatriots, he abandoned the Eternal Empire during his mission, and his story served as a warning to [[Zakuulan]]s about the allure of the Core Worlds.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Poor fool got homesick?|Alus, reacting to the story of Watcher Izax|<ref name="KOTET 6" />}}
[[File:Frem.png|thumb|right|170px|Captain Frem told the story of Watcher Izax.]]
Many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5}} In the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]]&mdash;which took place in the ''Knights of the Eternal Throne'' storyline&mdash;the [[Eternal Empire agents]], which include Watcher Izax, were said to have left for the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior.</ref> the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Spy/Legends|spied]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|outlands]], a [[Zakuulan]] term for the Core Worlds, using a [[Eternal Empire agents|network]] of sleeper [[Agent/Legends|agents]]. The most successful of the agents was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual codenamed Watcher Izax.<ref name="KOTET 6" /> He shared his code name with the [[God/Legends|god]] [[Izax]], the chief deity of the original Zakuulan [[Six Gods|pantheon]] before [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] claimed to have [[Demon Savior|toppled]] them.<ref name="God">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|The Six Gods}}</ref> The agent's career ended, however, when he abandoned the Eternal Empire for the outlands.<ref name="KOTET 6" />

In the year 3630 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> at the [[Palace of the Eternal Dragon]] on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Zakuul]], the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]] was held in celebration of Empress [[Vaylin]]'s [[War against Zakuul|war]] against the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] that opposed her. During the heavily-guarded festival, Watcher Izax's story was told by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Frem]] of the [[Knights of Zakuul]] to a group of other knights as a cautionary tale regarding the temptations of the outlands. Among the knights was an initiate named [[Alus]], who opined that Watcher Izax was a fool who got homesick before being rebuffed by Frem, who said that the spy was stronger than Alus would ever be.<ref name="KOTET 6" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He was a strong, loyal son of Zakuul. Until the day he abandoned his homeland.|Captain Frem on Watcher Izax|<ref name="KOTET 6" />}}
Watcher Izax was considered a loyal person by his people until he cut ties with the Eternal Empire. Although he betrayed the Empire, Zakuulans like Frem faulted the irresistible draw of the Core Worlds more than Watcher Izax's personality itself.<ref name="KOTET 6" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|The most successful of these agents was code-named Watcher Izax.|Captain Frem evaluates the Eternal Empire agents|<ref name="KOTET 6" />}}
The Eternal Empire considered Watcher Izax a strong person, capable of being an effective spy. After being sent to the Core Worlds, he achieved more success compared to his peers in the same role.<ref name="KOTET 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Watcher Izax was introduced via mention in [[BioWare]]'s [[2016]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] to its [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. During the mission "Chapter VI: The Dragon's Maw," Izax is mentioned in ambient conversation on the world of Zakuul.<ref name="KOTET 6" />
